visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide handheld shot of the entrance to JUNGLIA park in Okinawa. A massive crowd of tourists, many holding colorful umbrellas to block the sun, gathers in front of a giant stone sign. A group of adults in casual summer attire waves enthusiastically at the camera. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a wooden building where rows of rental strollers and wheelchairs are organized for visitors. Green plants are visible in the foreground, and the lighting is bright and natural. (3) A montage shows various dinosaur-themed merchandise in a gift shop, including rows of plush brachiosaurus toys, colorful headbands, and metallic dinosaur keychains hanging on wooden displays. (4) A male creator with a grey tank top and a backpack speaks directly to the camera while holding a small T-Rex toy. He is in the well-lit souvenir shop with shelves of merchandise behind him. (5) A yellow bus with the 'JUNGLIA' logo is shown, followed by the entrance to 'SPA JUNGLIA,' a Japanese-style building. Inside, clean shower stations with brown stools and modern toiletries are displayed. (6) The view moves outdoors to a series of light blue pools and a large infinity pool overlooking a lush green valley under an overcast sky. (7) A large hot air balloon with the park's logo sits on a grassy field, while a towering animatronic brachiosaurus stands tall against a backdrop of tropical trees and palm fronds. (8) On a wooden stage, a staff member in an explorer outfit, wearing a cowboy hat and green shirt, claps and shouts energetically to a crowd of visitors. (9) Families with young children, all wearing orange or yellow safety helmets, walk through a dense jungle path. They encounter realistic animatronic dinosaurs, including a stegosaurus and a raptor, which move their heads and open their mouths. (10) A large group of tourists poses for a photo in front of a full-sized T-Rex statue on a military-style truck. The scene transitions to a father holding a crying toddler on a paved path. (11) In a restaurant area, a wooden balcony designed like a bird's nest overlooks the park. A close-up shows a gourmet meat dish wrapped in bacon, served on a white plate with mashed potatoes. (12) Children run across a wide, paved plaza while adults walk nearby. The environment is open and sunny with distant forested hills. (13) A male musician in a white chef’s jacket and a brown hat plays an electric violin outdoors, followed by another musician playing a saxophone. The setting is bright and festive. (14) At night, a large crowd at the 'BREEZE ARENA' dances under purple and pink stage lights during a water show. Rain or artificial water sprays fall as performers in animal-print costumes dance on stage. (15) A female staff member in a green explorer outfit waves goodbye to the camera in front of a wooden building at night. (16) The video concludes with several shots of groups and individuals posing and waving in front of the giant 'JUNGLIA OKINAWA' entrance sign during the day.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 2025年全新開幕. [Logo]: JUNGLIA OKINAWA. [Slogan]: 沖繩 JUNGLIA 叢林樂園. (2) [Subtitle]: 先說一個大重點. [Variety]: 人潮比恐龍還兇猛. [Slogan]: 請一定要買豪華通行證. (3) [Subtitle]: 這次帶小至3歲大至60歲. 大大小小一起征服JUNGLIA. (4) [Variety]: 數量有限! 依現場數量為主!. [Subtitle]: 帶小孩的爸爸媽媽不用自己帶推車. 一進樂園就可以租借. (5) [Subtitle]: 還沒玩到設施商店就出現了各種. 恐龍娃娃, 恐龍髮箍, 恐龍鑰匙圈. (6) [Subtitle]: 我在迪士尼的時候. 都覺得Shine去買那種. 迪士尼的吊飾, 頭飾很像廢物. 但我剛看到我有點想要包耶. (7) [Logo]: SPA JUNGLIA. [Subtitle]: 再來我們前進到 SPA JUNGLIA. 要搭大巴士前往. 一到就有日式的湯屋感. (8) [Subtitle]: 因為是全裸SPA. 淋浴區乾淨舒適很重要. 室內湯屋區小小的. 但室外的SPA區很美. (9) [Variety]: 金氏世界紀錄認證. [Subtitle]: 還有一個 最大無邊際浴池. (10) [Subtitle]: 接著進入園區體驗設施. 遠遠的就有一隻超高的長頸龍. (11) [Variety]: 確定不是腕龍?. (12) [Logo]: FINDING DINOSAURS. [Subtitle]: 第一個推薦小朋友玩 FINDING DINOSAURS. 走入叢林探險的感覺. (13) [Subtitle]: 哇~好可愛喔. 這一隻是劍龍的寶寶. 莎莎快去掰掰. (14) [Variety]: 茶茶嚇到. [Subtitle]: 莎莎快跑快跑快跑. 阿茶, 她叫我抱她. (15) [Variety]: (聲明: 園區內無奇怪舅舅). (16) [Subtitle]: 姐夫要中暑, 姐夫要中暑. (17) [Logo]: DINOSAUR SAFARI. [Subtitle]: 下一個情緒很滿的 DINOSAUR SAFARI. 這個設施玩的過程中不能拍攝. 但我先說, 小孩真的會嚇爛. (18) [Subtitle]: 園區內也有餐廳. 記得提前要預約喔. 我們覺得還蠻好吃的. (19) [Subtitle]: 還有其他設施等著你去探索. 整個園區很大. 但遮蔽物不多. 強烈地建議一定要避開夏天. 小孩就可以跑跑跳跳地很開心. (20) [Logo]: WIND BEAT 南國音樂會. (21) [Subtitle]: 到晚上19:30. 準備看一場濕身秀. (22) [Subtitle]: 如果你問我JUNGLIA到底值不值得去. 我覺得真的見仁見智. 你要看季節. 有沒有買豪華通行證. 或者提前預約一些餐廳. (23) [Subtitle]: 如果有要前往. 我會建議先上 Klook 安排一趟舒服一點的叢林之旅.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video features a diverse range of backgrounds including a large stone theme park entrance, lush tropical jungle paths with artificial dinosaurs, a modern spa with both indoor showers and an outdoor infinity pool, a bright retail shop, a bird's nest-themed restaurant balcony, and a high-tech performance stage at night.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, fast-paced male narrator speaking over an upbeat, major-mode electronic pop BGM. The voice is clear and professional with a friendly tone. (2) As the scene moves into the gift shop, the narration becomes more conversational. The background music continues at a steady 128 BPM with a strong rhythmic beat. (3) A loud acoustic event occurs as staff members on stage shout 'Ho! Ho! Ho!' followed by an explosion of crowd cheering and laughter. (4) In the dinosaur path section, a layer of environmental jungle sounds (insects and wind) is added to the mix. Periodic sound effects of mechanical dinosaur growls and roars punctuate the narration. (5) A sharp acoustic transition happens as a child is heard crying loudly, mixing with the narrator's empathetic but still energetic commentary. (6) The audio shifts to a live performance segment where a bright, melodic electric violin solo takes the lead, followed by a crisp saxophone solo. (7) During the night show, the BGM switches to high-volume electronic dance music (EDM) with heavy bass. The sound of water splashing and intense crowd screaming creates a high-arousal acoustic atmosphere. (8) A female voice speaking Japanese politely says 'Arigatou gozaimasu' followed by 'Bye-bye' in a friendly tone. (9) The audio concludes with a final summary narration over a slightly lower-volume version of the opening BGM, maintaining a high speech density until the end.
